derived_files.modifications: Expanded the complete Responses output-item, content-part, text, reasoning, tool, usage and terminal lifecycle with stable identities and indices; deep-froze nested payloads; added target token names and a transport-neutral sequence wrapper.

Rebuilt sequencing as a strict item, content, tool and usage state machine; added a bounded acknowledged foreign-thread bridge, one terminal and usage authority, capped weakly reclaimed subscribers, bounded replay, and isolated slow-subscriber overflow.

Reduced request lifecycle and scheduler state to immutable target-owned row-planning contracts; omitted HTTP, model-pool, cache, parser and tensor ownership. omlx/request.py identifies vllm-mlx as an upstream source.
Recast continuous admission, late join, deferred cancellation and prefill/decode fairness as a dependency-free planner; GenerationTurn remains the sole event and terminal writer.

Rebuilt the one-thread request and tensor ownership lifecycle behind a target driver port; added strict runtime/request/lease identity, retryable abort and cleanup, bounded tombstones, facade leases and ordered shutdown without importing the donor server or control plane.
Retained explicit model-owner serialization and Qwen4Exp MTP rollback ownership as target lifecycle invariants while leaving tensor mechanics behind the unresolved ABI driver port.
Reduced donor batch operation concepts to target-owned homogeneous text/vision prefill and shared decode receipts, strict row/accounting validation and acknowledged cancellation cleanup.
Made exact MTP eligibility and rollback evidence explicit per scheduled decode batch, with fail-closed runtime facts and AR fallback until live semantic proof exists.

Defined the sole synchronous target execution boundary for Qwen4Exp reservation, exact MTP stepping, rollback, abort and cleanup while leaving model source untransplanted until dependency compatibility is proven.
Collapsed owner-thread batch execution and lifecycle expectations into one injected target port without importing the donor scheduler, model pool, server or control plane.

Reduced Qwen4Exp QSA, GDN and PLE speculative state to one opaque owner-thread transaction with snapshot, capture, validated commit, exact rollback, stale-lease protection and fail-closed poisoning after uncertain mutation.

Extracted complete execution geometry for Qwen4Exp text, MTP, PLE, QSA, M-RoPE and vision plus immutable module-specific quantization recipes, effective seed/EOS and vision token identity with no MLX or MLX-LM import.
Retained pure power-of-two QSA replay capacity and authoritative MTP-history repair planning while removing environment gates, cache duck typing and all tensor mutation.

Reduced mlx-vlm-derived decoding and multi-image preprocessing to immutable whole-request contracts, opaque tensor handles, an eight-image bound, exact grid and pad-row receipts, and fail-closed request identity validation.

Reduced the mlx-vlm-derived Qwen vision tower to injected opaque-row contracts that preserve per-image ordering, merged embedding row counts and optional deepstack receipts without owning tensor execution.
Recast mutable solo-lane vision splice state as an immutable content-keyed plan plus a request-local owner-thread cursor, exact image spans, pure lookup windows and stale-identity rejection.
Reimplemented the mlx-vlm-derived M-RoPE algorithm as a pure-Python immutable per-request table and digest with ordered multi-image grids and fail-closed video or pad-layout mismatch.

Recast donor namespace, parent-hash, lease, refcount, hot-LRU and optional SSD concepts as a tensor-free whole-boundary store for one opaque Qwen4Exp QSA, GDN, PLE and MTP checkpoint; added sealed media-context isolation and commit-only publication.
Extracted tensor-free target ports, namespace facts and cleanup receipts. omlx/paged_cache.py identifies vllm-mlx and vLLM v1 as upstream sources.
Expanded persisted-cache compatibility identity with target runtime, tokenizer, adapter, draft-model, MTP and TurboQuant dimensions.
Extracted namespace activation, request leasing and ordered idempotent cleanup into a coordinator that owns no tensors.
Reduced the exact probability-ratio verification and model MTP surfaces to protocol-neutral target contracts.
Adapted batch ownership, fallback reason and acceptance-stat concepts without copying the donor BatchGenerator.
Made MTPLX's multi-row AR fallback an explicit target decision and retained singleton exactness as the initial guarantee.
Conservatively gated the donor's opt-in row-wise MTP path behind an explicit live-proof switch and aligned-cohort contract.
Extracted model-family recognition into a static probe with no MLX imports; MTP remains false until the concrete adapter and ABI are proven at runtime.
Recorded Qwen4Exp text/VLM family support while exposing continuous batching, MTP and paged cache only as unproven contracts until a concrete adapter is verified.
Added target principal isolation, reason-bearing cancellation, target-owned environment namespacing, terminal waiting and delete-race protection while retaining bounded MTPLX lifecycle semantics.
Recast Qwen XML and JSON envelope parsing and marker suppression as a stateless cumulative ToolDialect with stable target-owned call identity.
Retained MTPLX Qwen fallback behavior and malformed-envelope discipline while removing tokenizer, server and registry ownership.
Converted Harmony channel visibility and tool-recipient behavior from tokenizer-session output into a cumulative text ToolDialect.
Adapted mlx-vlm-derived image preprocessing into an ordered eight-image owner-thread implementation bound to the target immutable checkpoint load plan.
Adapted the mlx-vlm-derived tower to Qwen4Exp target naming, immutable shard mapping, exact module quantization, request receipts and owner-thread affinity.
Replaced implicit request state with an identity-bound target cursor and exact tensor windows for prefill and MTP history replay.
Adapted the transitively MIT mlx-vlm M-RoPE algorithm into explicit per-request batch-one tensors while preserving dense-causal vision and sparse text selection semantics.

Adapted the frozen NumPy sampler into a target-owned pure contract for deterministic filtering, per-request RNG, probability-ratio acceptance, residual correction and marginal-oracle tests; tensor execution wiring remains separately gated.

Adapted the Qwen4Exp QSA, GDN, PLE and embedded MTP tensor trunk to strict immutable target load plans, injected optional kernels and a batch-one row-serial execution port. Added exact greedy and stochastic singleton MTP verification, residual correction, request-local RNG, AR history repair, and sealed multi-image preprocessing/tower/splice/M-RoPE execution; all remain runtime-unverified under Compile Embargo.

Adapted selective resident PLE shard lookup so each token touches only its required packed shard. Also retained the one-gather packed-shard fusion behind an explicit target capability and physical-memory admission, without importing the donor runtime or control plane.
Replaced donor process-global feature discovery with request-local context variables and explicit target-injected optional-kernel capability gates.
